## Checklist

<!-- Definition of done, docs/standards/process.md PROC-7. Tick only what is true. -->

- [ ] An accepted ADR covers this change, or it needs none (PROC-1 to PROC-3)
- [ ] Does what the ADR says and nothing more (PRIN-2, PROC-9)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (TEST-1 to TEST-6)
- [ ] Works with keyboard only and a screen reader; 320 px and 200% text checked (UI-6 to UI-16)
- [ ] Every new text in English and Dutch (UI-20)
- [ ] Behind a release flag, or the flag is removed (CODE-20)
- [ ] No new personal data or third party, or the ADR and data inventory cover it (SEC-10, SEC-11)
- [ ] ADRs and standards still match what was built (PROC-11)
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes
